title: Where-used list
description: A venture's where-used list (<venture>/knowledge/where-used.json, EE-042): for each fact kept once in its system of record (a parent, such as a product's price), every place that repeats it (its children: a pricing page, a newsletter, a payment provider, a constant in code). Update the parent once and the children show what must follow. The framework checks live children offline and reports drift (packages/naive/src/checks/check-where-used.mjs); delivering the change into a vendor's system is the platform's (coexistence or centralized style). Written for a fast model to read: every field present.

parent.description: Where the fact is mastered: a record route and a JSON pointer into it

route.description: A record route, such as purpose/product/shop-app

pointer.description: A JSON pointer to the value, such as /price

source.description: A source id from knowledge/sources.json, or venture for the venture's own folder

template.description: How the value appears in the text, {value} standing for it, such as $ {value}/month

status.description: live: must always show the parent's value. frozen: history that keeps the value it had (a newsletter already sent, a past invoice); never checked or changed

deliver.description: Who carries a change to this child: an agent through a handoff, a person, or the platform's sync
